verdict.rationale: Missive documents an official MCP server (docs/ai/mcp/server) that lets external AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor act on conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts with user-chosen permissions. The changelog cites inbox summarization, draft replies, and agent triage against a CRM, and notes that drafts created through the API and MCP server resolve user variables. However, nothing in the evidence shows an external agent can actually send email, so the end-to-end loop is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit send capability via MCP/API, a published tool list or OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
